scope: cached installed source inspection only; no SDK/module execution, credentials or network
facts: Core auth signer passes explicit signingDate derived from Date.now plus mutable clock offset by default; disabling correction alone still uses new Date.
Core config.signer supplies actual signer invoked by sign; a narrowly bound wrapper can override signingDate while preserving actual signing.
S3 getSignedUrl constructs its own presigner, forwarding options including signingDate; client signer replacement alone does not cover it.
SigV4 presigner defaults new Date only when signingDate is absent.
limitations: Source inspection is not intercepted call-path or native qualification.
Credential cache/expiry, JWT/session/TLS source binding and actual final request date checks remain integration obligations.
